020package com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.checks.javadoc;
021
022import java.util.ArrayDeque;
023import java.util.Deque;
024import java.util.regex.Pattern;
025
026import javax.annotation.Nullable;
027
028import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.FileStatefulCheck;
029import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.api.DetailAST;
030import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.api.DetailNode;
031import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.api.JavadocCommentsTokenTypes;
032import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.api.TokenTypes;
033import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.utils.CommonUtil;
034import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.utils.JavadocUtil;
035import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.utils.NullUtil;
036
037/**
038 * <div>
039 * Requires user defined Javadoc tag to be present in Javadoc comment with defined format.
040 * To define the format for a tag, set property tagFormat to a regular expression.
041 * Violations are reported only when the configured tag is missing or when the tag content
042 * does not match tagFormat.
043 * No violation is reported when the tag is present and matches tagFormat (or when tagFormat
044 * is not configured).
045 * No violation reported in case there is no javadoc.
046 * To forbid tags instead of requiring them, use IllegalBlockTag.
047 * </div>
048 *
049 * @since 4.2
050 */
051@FileStatefulCheck
052public class WriteTagCheck extends AbstractJavadocCheck {
053
054    /**
055     * A key is pointing to the warning message text in "messages.properties"
056     * file.
057     */
058    public static final String MSG_MISSING_TAG = "writetag.missingTag";
059
060    /**
061     * A key is pointing to the warning message text in "messages.properties"
062     * file.
063     */
064    public static final String MSG_TAG_FORMAT = "writetag.tagFormat";
065
066    /** Specify the regexp to match tag content. */
067    private Pattern tagFormat;
068
069    /** Specify the name of tag. */
070    private String tag;
071
072    /** Whether the target tag was found in the current Javadoc tree. */
073    private boolean tagFound;
074
075    /** Parent AST for the missing tag report in the current Javadoc tree. */
076    private DetailAST parentAst;
077
078    /**
079     * Creates a new {@code WriteTagCheck} instance.
080     */
081    public WriteTagCheck() {
082        // no code by default
083    }
084
085    /**
086     * Setter to specify the name of tag.
087     *
088     * @param tag tag to check
089     * @since 4.2
090     */
091    public void setTag(String tag) {
092        this.tag = tag;
093    }
094
095    /**
096     * Setter to specify the regexp to match tag content.
097     *
098     * @param pattern a {@code String} value
099     * @since 4.2
100     */
101    public void setTagFormat(Pattern pattern) {
102        tagFormat = pattern;
103    }
104
105    /**
106     * Setter to control when to print violations if the Javadoc being examined by this check
107     * violates the tight html rules defined at
108     * <a href="https://checkstyle.org/writingjavadocchecks.html#Tight-HTML_rules">
109     *     Tight-HTML Rules</a>.
110     *
111     * @param shouldReportViolation value to which the field shall be set to
112     * @since 8.3
113     * @propertySince 13.9.0
114     */
115    @Override
116    public void setViolateExecutionOnNonTightHtml(boolean shouldReportViolation) {
117        super.setViolateExecutionOnNonTightHtml(shouldReportViolation);
118    }
119
120    @Override
121    public int[] getRequiredTokens() {
122        return CommonUtil.EMPTY_INT_ARRAY;
123    }
124
125    @Override
126    public int[] getDefaultTokens() {
127        return new int[] {
128            TokenTypes.INTERFACE_DEF,
129            TokenTypes.CLASS_DEF,
130            TokenTypes.ENUM_DEF,
131            TokenTypes.ANNOTATION_DEF,
132            TokenTypes.RECORD_DEF,
133        };
134    }
135
136    @Override
137    public int[] getAcceptableTokens() {
138        return new int[] {
139            TokenTypes.INTERFACE_DEF,
140            TokenTypes.CLASS_DEF,
141            TokenTypes.ENUM_DEF,
142            TokenTypes.ANNOTATION_DEF,
143            TokenTypes.METHOD_DEF,
144            TokenTypes.CTOR_DEF,
145            TokenTypes.ENUM_CONSTANT_DEF,
146            TokenTypes.ANNOTATION_FIELD_DEF,
147            TokenTypes.RECORD_DEF,
148            TokenTypes.COMPACT_CTOR_DEF,
149        };
150    }
151
152    @Override
153    public int[] getDefaultJavadocTokens() {
154        return new int[] {
155            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.JAVADOC_BLOCK_TAG,
156        };
157    }
158
159    @Override
160    public int[] getRequiredJavadocTokens() {
161        return getAcceptableJavadocTokens();
162    }
163
164    @Override
165    public void visitToken(DetailAST ast) {
166        final DetailAST javadocComment = findJavadoc(ast);
167        if (javadocComment != null) {
168            parentAst = ast;
169            super.visitToken(javadocComment);
170        }
171    }
172
173    @Override
174    public void beginJavadocTree(DetailNode rootAst) {
175        tagFound = false;
176    }
177
178    @Override
179    public void visitJavadocToken(DetailNode ast) {
180        final String tagName = "@" + JavadocUtil.getTagName(ast);
181        if (tagName.equals(tag)) {
182            tagFound = true;
183            final String content = getTagContent(ast);
184
185            if (tagFormat != null && !tagFormat.matcher(content).find()) {
186                log(ast.getLineNumber(), MSG_TAG_FORMAT, tag, tagFormat.pattern());
187            }
188        }
189    }
190
191    @Override
192    public void finishJavadocTree(DetailNode rootAst) {
193        if (tag != null && !tagFound) {
194            log(parentAst, MSG_MISSING_TAG, tag);
195        }
196    }
197
198    /**
199     * Returns the raw content of the tag.
200     *
201     * @param javadocBlockTagNode The node representing a Javadoc block tag.
202     *       This node must be of type {@link JavadocCommentsTokenTypes#JAVADOC_BLOCK_TAG}
203     * @return The raw content of the tag.
204     */
205    private static String getTagContent(DetailNode javadocBlockTagNode) {
206        final DetailNode tagNodeNextSibling = JavadocUtil.findFirstToken(
207            javadocBlockTagNode.getFirstChild(),
208            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.TAG_NAME).getNextSibling();
209
210        final int stringBuilderCapacity = 128;
211        final StringBuilder rawTextBuilder = new StringBuilder(stringBuilderCapacity);
212        if (tagNodeNextSibling != null) {
213            // DFS to extract texts of all leaf nodes
214            final Deque<DetailNode> stack = new ArrayDeque<>();
215            stack.push(tagNodeNextSibling);
216
217            while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
218                final DetailNode currentNode = stack.pop();
219
220                // append text if node is a leaf
221                if (currentNode.getFirstChild() == null) {
222                    rawTextBuilder.append(currentNode.getText());
223                }
224
225                final DetailNode nextSibling = currentNode.getNextSibling();
226                final DetailNode firstChild = currentNode.getFirstChild();
227
228                if (nextSibling != null) {
229                    stack.push(nextSibling);
230                }
231                if (firstChild != null) {
232                    stack.push(firstChild);
233                }
234            }
235        }
236
237        return rawTextBuilder.toString().stripLeading();
238    }
239
240    /**
241     * Finds the Javadoc comment associated with a structural AST node.
242     *
243     * @param ast the structural node (e.g., CLASS_DEF, METHOD_DEF)
244     * @return the Javadoc block comment if found, or null
245     */
246    @Nullable
247    private static DetailAST findJavadoc(DetailAST ast) {
248        DetailAST cmt = ast.findFirstToken(TokenTypes.BLOCK_COMMENT_BEGIN);
249        if (cmt == null) {
250            final DetailAST modifiers = NullUtil.notNull(ast.findFirstToken(TokenTypes.MODIFIERS));
251            final DetailAST type = ast.findFirstToken(TokenTypes.TYPE);
252
253            final DetailAST annotation = modifiers.findFirstToken(TokenTypes.ANNOTATION);
254            cmt = modifiers.findFirstToken(TokenTypes.BLOCK_COMMENT_BEGIN);
255            if (annotation != null) {
256                cmt = annotation.findFirstToken(TokenTypes.BLOCK_COMMENT_BEGIN);
257            }
258            if (cmt == null && type != null) {
259                cmt = type.findFirstToken(TokenTypes.BLOCK_COMMENT_BEGIN);
260            }
261        }
262        return cmt;
263    }
264
265}
